test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: If 6 November 1925 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 16 December 1933?
solution: Given: **6 November 1925** was Friday. Now, 1925 to 1933 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Year and 2 Leap Year). And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Year. So, 2 Leap Year has 4 odd days, And, 6 Ordinary Year has 6 odd days. Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.
